hook.text: Instagram was just a photo filter app at launch. It was useful even if nobody else was on it.

buildup.text: Single-player mode means the product has standalone value before network effects kick in.

discovery.text: OpenTable gave restaurants a free reservation system. Useful alone, but magical once diners joined.

twist.text: Most failed platforms skipped single-player mode. They needed both sides from day one—an impossible ask.

climax.text: Single-player mode is the safest way to solve the chicken-and-egg problem. Deliver value immediately.

punchline.text: Make it useful for one person first. The network comes later.
